highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.154.0 preview updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154.
highlights_body: It also aligns HarfBuzzSharp binding generation with the native source pinned by the bundled Skia build.

breaking.title: UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 was renamed
breaking.body: Use `UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC132` instead of `CCC133`. The numeric value remains 132, but the managed name now matches corrected upstream HarfBuzz naming.

breaking.title: GlyphFlags.Defined was removed
breaking.body: Combine the concrete `GlyphFlags` values your code needs instead of using the aggregate `GlyphFlags.Defined` mask.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled graphics engine to Chrome milestone 154.

preview_summaries.v4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9: Preview 1 opens the m154 line with the bundled engine update and synchronized HarfBuzzSharp generation.
